open_points.subject: check_value_forms
open_points.text: check_value_forms: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST answer one RefusalFailure, carrying the value's path, for every form value outside its form and none for the others, in the order of form_values, each value's form chosen by its field of = models.FormField and each failure's kind the one the imported FORM_FIELD_REFUSAL_KINDS constant gives for that field: a value of the ALIAS member of = models.FormField longer than the imported ALIAS_MAX_CHARACTERS constant counted in Unicode code points, one of the FLOOR_AREA member of = models.FormField for which _read_decimal_text answers None or whose Decimal is not greater than the imported OBJECT_FLOOR_AREA_MIN_EXCLUSIVE constant, one of the ROOMS_COUNT member of = models.FormField for which _read_whole_number_text answers None or whose integer is less than the imported OBJECT_ROOMS_MIN constant, one of the FLOOR member of = models.FormField for which _read_whole_number_text answers None, one of the OBJECT_KIND member of = models.FormField outside = models.ObjectKind, one of the CUSTOMER_LANGUAGE member of = models.FormField outside = models.CustomerLanguage or one of the CUSTOMER_KIND member of = models.FormField outside = models.CustomerKind.
open_points.question: The requirement supplies a FormField as the lookup subject and requires the result to be a RefusalFailure kind, but the constant accepts str keys and returns str values; specify whether lookup uses the field member name or value and how the returned string is converted to RefusalKind, or change the constant signature to Mapping[FormField, RefusalKind].
